description: Start the engine of a Cessna 172 Skyhawk from cold and dark while lined up on the runway, configure it for takeoff (flaps 10, landing light), release the parking brake, apply full power, rotate at 55 knots and establish a climb at about 75 knots. Seen as the simulator's cockpit view: windshield on top, instrument panel below.

steps.completion_cue: The red BAT / ALT master rocker switch is up (ON).

steps.instruction_es: Gira el selector de combustible a BOTH.
steps.completion_cue: The fuel selector pointer points at BOTH.

steps.instruction_es: Empuja la mezcla a fondo, a rica.
steps.completion_cue: The red MIXTURE knob is pushed fully in, flush with the panel.

steps.instruction_es: Gira la llave a START para arrancar el motor.
steps.completion_cue: The propeller is spinning and the tachometer shows about 1000 RPM with the key on BOTH.
The flap lever sits in the 10 degree detent and the flap indicator shows 10.
The LAND rocker switch is up (ON).
The PARK BRAKE handle is pushed in and no red SET flag is visible.

steps.instruction_es: Ahora potencia máxima: empuja el acelerador a fondo.
steps.completion_cue: The THROTTLE knob is fully in, the tachometer shows about 2300 RPM and the airspeed is rising.

steps.instruction_es: Al llegar a 55 nudos, tira suavemente del comando para rotar.
steps.completion_cue: With at least 55 knots the nose is up about 8 degrees and the wheels have left the runway.

steps.instruction_es: Mantén la nariz unos 7 grados arriba y sube a 75 nudos.
steps.completion_cue: Airborne with about 7 degrees nose up, 70 to 80 knots and the vertical speed above 500 ft/min.

mistakes.description: The key is turned to START before the master switch is on, the fuel selector is on BOTH and the mixture is rich: the engine won't start.
mistakes.visual_cue: The ignition key is on START while the master switch is down, the fuel selector shows OFF or the red mixture knob is pulled out; the propeller doesn't keep spinning.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, así no arranca. Antes de girar la llave: maestro encendido, combustible en BOTH y mezcla rica.

mistakes.description: Flaps are set to 30 degrees for takeoff instead of 10.
mistakes.visual_cue: The flap lever is at the bottom 30 degree detent and the flap indicator shows 30.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, 30 grados de flaps es demasiado para despegar. Súbelos a 10.

mistakes.description: Full power is applied while the parking brake is still set: the plane doesn't move.
mistakes.visual_cue: The throttle knob is fully in and the tachometer is high, but the PARK BRAKE handle is pulled out with its red SET flag and the airspeed stays at zero.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, tienes el freno de estacionamiento puesto. Reduce la potencia y suelta el freno antes de acelerar.

mistakes.description: The pilot pulls the yoke before reaching 55 knots, risking a stall on takeoff.
mistakes.visual_cue: The nose is pitched up while the airspeed needle is below 50 knots and the red STALL light is lit.
mistakes.correction_es: ¡Ojo, muy temprano! Baja la nariz y espera los 55 nudos para rotar.
